title: FACE IDENTITY
prompt:
FACE IDENTITY
Beautiful adult South Korean woman in her early 20s, with delicate Korean facial features, balanced facial proportions, and a natural, soft expression.

BODY
Approximately 163 cm tall. Naturally slim feminine physique with elegant Korean proportions, naturally full proportional bust with realistic weight and softness, slim toned waist, subtle hourglass silhouette, gently rounded hips, long slender legs, delicate shoulders, defined collarbones, and fair porcelain skin with realistic texture.

OUTFIT
Cropped light-blue washed denim bolero jacket with an open front and silver chain hardware beneath the chest.

Simple fitted black bandeau top underneath, creating a modern fashion-forward look.

Ultra-low-rise distressed micro denim shorts with a frayed hem and dual black side straps wrapping around both hips, exposing the upper hip bones while remaining a complete wearable outfit.

Minimal silver jewelry, small hoop earrings, no hat.

SCENE
Golden hour at a quiet rooftop café overlooking a modern Korean city skyline. Concrete floor, warm sunlight reflecting from nearby buildings, wooden chairs and café tables softly blurred in the background, and subtle plants around the edges.

Clean urban aesthetic with a luxury fashion editorial atmosphere.

COMPOSITION
Vertical 4:5 portrait, medium-close framing from mid-thigh upward, eye-level perspective. Subject fills most of the frame, keeping the outfit as the primary focus while the rooftop environment remains softly visible. Natural depth of field without excessive background blur.

MOVEMENT / FACIAL EXPRESSION
Standing casually beside the café railing. One hand resting lightly in the shorts pocket while the other gently adjusts the cropped denim jacket. Relaxed posture with one hip slightly shifted. Looking directly into the camera with a soft, confident expression and a subtle closed-lip smile.

HAIR
Short black bob with soft wispy bangs, natural volume, and slight movement from a gentle rooftop breeze.

LIGHTING
Warm golden-hour sunlight from the side. Soft highlights on the face, shoulders, collarbones, and legs. Natural shadows and realistic skin tones.

STYLE / QUALITY
Ultra-photorealistic luxury Korean fashion editorial. Natural skin texture, realistic fabric folds, detailed denim texture, authentic smartphone-like color rendering, high detail, premium lifestyle photography. No CGI, no AI artifacts
